Game Overview

In Baby Sniper In Vietnam, the core idea is straightforward: navigate the gritty war-torn landscapes of Vietnam as Minh, a baby-turned-sniper on a path of vengeance. With easy-to-master controls and an intense atmosphere, precision and stealth become your allies. Experience high-stakes action and unravel an intriguing story of personal vendetta in this visually captivating shooter.
